title: A number guessing game
description:
The computer picks a number; the player guesses with hints.

```
I'm thinking of a number from 1 to 100.
Guess: 50
Too high
Guess: 25
Too low
Guess: 37
Got it in 3 guesses!
```
hints: `if (!int.TryParse(line, out int guess)) { Console.WriteLine("Type a number"); continue; }`.
`break` out of the loop when the guess is right, after printing the count.
requirements: Pick the number with `Random.Shared.Next(1, 101)`; for testing, a fixed seed is fine.
Use a `while` loop; count the guesses.
Input that is not a number prints `Type a number` and does not count.
stretch: Give the player 7 guesses at most, and ask whether to play again.
